name: plugin.mantis_sandbox_verifier
description: Google Mantis sandboxed crash reproduction, vulnerability PoC execution, and transactional patch verification

entrypoints.name: mantis_sandbox_exec
entrypoints.description: Execute a shell or binary command securely inside an isolated subprocess sandbox with explicit pipe disposal

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command string to execute within the sandbox

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum execution duration before process termination

entrypoints.name: mantis_reproduce_crash
entrypoints.description: Execute a proof-of-concept crash reproducer script against a target file in sandbox isolation

parameters.name: reproducer_script
parameters.description: Python or shell script content designed to trigger the vulnerability

parameters.name: target_file
parameters.description: Target source file or binary path being audited

entrypoints.name: mantis_patch_verify
entrypoints.description: Apply a candidate security fix in transactional shadow isolation and verify it blocks the crash reproducer

parameters.name: diff_content
parameters.description: Unified diff content representing the candidate patch

parameters.name: reproducer_script
parameters.description: Crash reproducer script that triggered the baseline failure

parameters.name: run_bypass_reattack
parameters.description: Whether to run fresh re-attack variants to test patch bypass resistance
